integrity: The proof reduces maximality of the constant to the published equivalence with the generalized James constant, then proves an exact exposed-face separation lemma for the regular octagon. The bundled checker verifies the finite facet incidences and equality configuration over Q(sqrt(2)). No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the saturation threshold, not the complete function C_{-infinity}(a,X_8) below sqrt(2), and it does not classify other polygonal or symmetric absolute norms.
title: Sharp saturation threshold for the generalized minimum von Neumann–Jordan constant of the regular octagon
